verdicts.rationale: Clean reproduction confirmed: POST /collections/create with collection_name='test_dup' succeeded twice in sequence (both returned HTTP 200 with empty body). Independent verification via has_collection() returns True after first creation, proving collection exists. Source code analysis (handler_v2.go:1795-2062) shows createCollection handler performs NO duplicate existence check before proxy.CreateCollection() call - it only validates schema and parameters. This allows duplicate creation to succeed silently, violating idempotency expectations and potentially causing resource leaks or inconsistency. This matches REST_v2_data_type_handling pattern - REST v2 fails to enforce validation invariants.
